evaluation_title: Independent Evaluation of Fine-Tuned YOLOv8m on Held-Out Test Set

false_alarm_details.description: False alarm on barrier gate overhead structural canopy during empty gate frame.

false_negatives_details.reason: Queued passenger car heavily occluded in upper background behind lead heavy truck; dataset contains only 1 passenger car instance in test set.
Severe edge truncation where vehicle enters ingress lane; model predicted box slightly below 0.25 conf threshold.

failure_modes_audit.false_positives_summary: 9 total false alarms across 72 frames (0.125 FP/frame), occurring exclusively on metal barrier gate stanchions, toll booth canopy trusses, and road curb boundaries in DAYLIGHT (7) and EVENING_IR (2). NIGHT_IR had 0 false positives.

implementation_audit.coordinate_format: xyxy absolute pixel coordinates verified across GT and model predictions; no xyxy vs xywh mismatch.
implementation_audit.class_mapping: Consistently mapped single domain class 'vehicle' (id=0) to all annotated vehicle instances.
implementation_audit.iou_calculation: Standard intersection over union computed with float precision.
implementation_audit.matching_uniqueness: Strict greedy matching by descending confidence ensures each GT box is matched at most once.
implementation_audit.duplicate_prediction_handling: Duplicate/unmatched predictions are strictly counted as False Positives.
implementation_audit.ap_integration: Official COCO 101-point interpolated precision-recall integration verified.
implementation_audit.ap50_95_thresholds: All 10 IoU thresholds (0.50:0.05:0.95) are evaluated and averaged.
implementation_audit.empty_frame_handling: Gracefully evaluated without zero-division; empty frame predictions registered as FP.
